headline: Adopted 90-day trail and signage rules for Martin Farm, Corneliusen and Ferdinando properties.
summary: Trails stay open during crop work, but new signs will ask people to stay out of the fields. Signs at Martin Farm can stay until the end of the planting season, and signs facing the town-owned Corneliusen parcel will be removed. The rules last 90 days while a permanent solution is worked out.
decisions: Approved nine trail and signage provisions for 90 days, 3-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Chabot MOTIONED to adopt the provisions one through nine contained in the email entitled “Recap of Meeting 8/21,” dated August 21, 2026, at 2:39 p.m., and to include in addition the provisions for the proper dimensions of signage required by state statute, in accordance with which the signs would be posted, for a period of 90 days. ... Vote: Unanimous
